source_path.fact: Completion conversion passes request.rid to GenerateReqInput.
ForwardBatch construction sets rids=[req.rid for req in batch.reqs].
Response meta_info.id is the runtime RID, matching the preserved SSE ID.

localized_defect: capture_offset_taps.py registered explicit runtime IDs only inside the is_extend() branch even though the pinned runtime transports ForwardBatch.rids at every logits boundary; cached/mixed boundary ordering can therefore reach a tap before ownership registration.
